name: domain.network_forensics
description: Network traffic metadata analyzer, TLS cert inspector, and port security auditor

entrypoints.name: audit_port_configuration
entrypoints.description: Audit open ports and exposed network services against security best practices

parameters.name: open_ports
parameters.description: List of port numbers or objects ({'port': 22, 'service': 'ssh'})

entrypoints.name: analyze_packet_summary
entrypoints.description: Analyze network flows (IP source/dest, protocol, packet sizes, flags) for port scans and DDoS signatures

entrypoints.name: inspect_tls_certificate
entrypoints.description: Validate TLS/SSL certificate metadata (issuer, expiration, cipher suites)
